title: Phase 0 result record
description: docs/phase0/results/<spike>/<record-id>/record.json (spike S1 to S5, or the optional non-gating X1). Immutable once committed. Contains identifiers and hashes only; no absolute host paths, user names or host names. Three kinds: spike-run and repro (the outcome of runs; a repeat run writes only repro records) and review (the reviewed judgement of S2.7, see the kind review rule below). The status pending is never stored: the verdict of a spike-run record stays PASS or FAIL, and the S2 status pending is derived only when every other S2 scenario passed, the automated S2.7 checks pass and no review record names the newest spike-run under the current criteria version; a review of an older run does not affect this status. For the derived current verdict, any repro record of the current criteria version at or after the newest spike-run with verdict FAIL keeps the current verdict at FAIL; a passing repro does not clear it, and a newer spike-run supersedes older repro results (data-model.md, Acceptance scenario).

record_id.description: <spike>-<UTC timestamp, basic format>-v<criteria version>; repro records use the repro- prefix, review records the review-S2- prefix.

gating.description: False for X1 records: the experiment never gates an ADR. Required for X1, absent otherwise.

criteria_sha256.description: Must equal the lock entry of this criteria version in docs/phase0/criteria/frozen.lock.

verdict.description: PASS iff every scenario of the named criteria version is present with outcome pass. A missing scenario counts as fail. Never pending. In an S2 spike-run record the S2.7 outcome is that of its automated step checks, so a failed step check makes the verdict FAIL; the S2 status is pending only when those checks pass, every other S2 scenario passed and no review record names the newest spike-run under the current criteria version; a review of an older run does not affect this status. Any other failed scenario makes the verdict FAIL regardless of review. For the derived current verdict, any repro record of the current criteria version at or after the newest spike-run with verdict FAIL keeps the current verdict at FAIL; a passing repro does not clear it, and a newer spike-run supersedes older repro results. The status is never read from this field alone.

fallback_decision.description: Required on FAIL for S1 to S5, including a failing S2 review record: the fallback that applies (spec FR-007, FR-031); omitted for X1, which has no fallback.

coverage.description: Numbers behind SC-005 (crash points enumerated and executed per kill mode), SC-006 (predicted versus actual file sets), SC-007 (transitions), SC-008 (rebuild durations).

required_settings.description: Mount or share settings found necessary (FR-013), the create policy, branch modes and out-of-space settings (S1.2, S1.9), the verified procedure for branch changes made directly by the mover (S1.10), the written recovery procedure of S2.7.

residual_risk.description: At least: device-level volatile write caches are not emulated; virtual disks stand in for real disks.

supersedes.description: Earlier record that this run re-runs after a documented design correction. The earlier record is never deleted.

repro_runs.description: kind=repro only: the run ids of the three consecutive clean runs (SC-004). A repeat run writes only this repro record and no spike-run record, so these ids are not separate records: the per-scenario outcomes of the three runs are combined in scenarios (pass only if all three passed, flaky if they differ, otherwise the common outcome) and their evidence is in this record's archive. A repro record never counts as the newest spike-run (data-model.md, Spike).

reviewed_record.description: kind=review only: the id of the S2 spike-run record whose S2.7 this record judges. It must name the same criteria version and criteria_sha256 as this record.

review.description: kind=review only: the reviewed judgement of the written recovery procedure (S2.7, spec FR-002).

outcome.description: The final S2.7 outcome. Only pass and fail exist: a review that is not yet made is the absence of this record (the derived status pending).

reviewer.description: Reviewer identity as a public handle or role; no host name, no e-mail address.

evidence.description: What was reviewed: entries inside the evidence archive of the reviewed record (for example the rendered procedure text), pinned by hash.

tool_versions.description: Observed inside the guest or on the host at run time, not copied from documentation.

snapraid_btrfs.description: Pinned revision of the snapshot tooling, if used.

kernel_config.description: Pre-flight results as read from the running kernel (for X1: CONFIG_FUSE_PASSTHROUGH and CONFIG_OVERLAY_FS_REDIRECT_DIR; for S1 to S4: btrfs and FUSE support).

cpu_class.description: CPU model class only (for example vendor and family); no host name.

kvm.description: Must be true for a record; a run without KVM never produces one.

outcome.description: For a scenario with cases: pass only if every case with gating true (or without a gating flag) is pass; cases with gating false never change it. For S2.7 in an S2 spike-run record: the outcome of the automated step checks only; the final S2.7 outcome comes from the review record, and a failed step check makes it fail without review.

gating.description: False for an informational variant case (S1.2, S1.6, S1.8: create policy lus, passthrough.io=rw, cache.files=auto-full): its outcome and evidence are recorded but never change the scenario outcome or the verdict. Absent means true.
